verdict.rationale: Stripe offers building blocks for background automation: webhooks push real-time events so an integration can automatically trigger reactions, and Smart Disputes automates evidence collection and submission. The MCP server also lets AI agents act on the Stripe API. However, the user must build and host the webhook handlers or agent logic themselves, and none of this is a Terminal-specific automation feature. missing for 10: native user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduled or background agent runs, Terminal-specific automation docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
